messages:
alex: Hey team — need to remove my spouse from benefits. She moved abroad for a permanent job on 2026-09-20 and I submitted the removal request on 2026-10-10, but premiums for October were already deducted. Can we get the coverage end date backdated to 2026-09-20 and get a refund/credit for Oct premiums?

taylor (People Ops): Hi Alex 34. Sorry for the hassle. Short answer: we can evaluate retro removals for qualifying life events (permanent move overseas counts if it's a change in household). We need supporting docs (employment contract/visa showing permanent relocation OR a utility/lease in spouse's name abroad) and the completed Dependent Removal form. Did you indicate permanent relocation on the Workday task?

alex: I put "moved for full-time job" in Workday but didn't attach docs at the time. I can upload the offer + visa paperwork and a copy of her new rental agreement.

jess (Benefits): Thanks. If approved, Benefits will adjust enrollment and notify Payroll to prorate premiums. Two notes: 1) We generally set the dependent termination date to the date the spouse lost eligibility (move date 2026-09-20), and 2) refunds/credits depend on payroll timing and whether premium deductions already posted. Please upload docs and we'll start the review.

mike (Payroll): Payroll-side: if Benefits approves a retro termination we can either issue a one-time payroll adjustment (refund) or apply a credit to future premiums. We typically require the request within 90 days of the event and the final documentation. If the deduction already hit a prior pay period, refunds are processed in the next available payroll cycle once we receive Benefits' directive. Also note tax withholding can affect net refund amounts.

alex: Ok uploading now: spouse_offer_2026-09.pdf, spouse_lease_spain_2026-09.pdf, workday_removal_request_2026-10.pdf

hr-bot: Form: /hr/forms/dependent-removal.pdf (fillable). Upload under Benefits > Documentation or attach to the Workday task. Link: https://intranet.redwood/hr/forms/dependent-removal

jess (Benefits): Received the docs. We'll review and aim to respond within 3 business days. If approved we'll set termination effective 2026-09-20 and notify Payroll to process a refund/credit.

alex: Couple quick followups: 1) Will spouse be eligible for COBRA if we terminate? 2) Will changing eligibility impact my HSA contributions (I was on family plan until removal)?

jess (Benefits): 1) COBRA: yes, if spouse loses coverage due to loss of eligibility they should be offered COBRA (but COBRA rules vary for non-US residences; we will include the COBRA notice and coordinate with our COBRA administrator). 2) HSA: moving from family to individual coverage may affect contribution limits. If you were making pre-tax HSA payroll contributions as family, you'll need to update elections; contact Payroll or Benefits to change deferrals for the next payroll period.

mike (Payroll): To change HSA pre-tax contributions mid-year you'll need to submit a benefits election change in Workday (we can process an election change when dependent removal is approved). Payroll will adjust upcoming deductions; we can't change prior withheld HSA funds retroactively beyond standard correction windows.

alex: Thanks everyone. I'll confirm after COBRA/materials come through. Appreciate the quick help.

jess (Benefits): Filing note: If anything else is missing we'll ping here. Once COBRA packet generated we'll attach to the Workday task. :white_check_mark:
